Validate Query Triplets via BOLD Preprocessor

bold_validate_query.Rd

Query triplets should be validated and matched before requesting query tokens. This step is automatically applied to queries generated by bold_get_query()

Usage

bold_validate_query(query, max_chars = 240)

Arguments

query

Character string of semicolon-separated query triplets (e.g., "tax:Aves;geo:Argentina").

max_chars

Integer. Maximum character length per preprocessor request chunk. Default is 240.

Value

A list containing successful_terms returned by the BOLD query preprocessor API.

See also

Other bold: .chunk_query_terms(), bold_download(), bold_get_query(), bold_get_token(), bold_read_data(), bold_retrieve(), bold_write_data()
